basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old mechanical engineer based in Seattle, WA. My passion for mecha and robotics has been a lifelong journey, beginning with my childhood fascination with sci-fi and culminating in a career designing advanced robotic systems for manufacturing. When I'm not at work, you'll find me immersed in gaming, particularly strategy and collectible card games like Plants vs. Zombies Heroes. I enjoy dissecting game mechanics and optimizing strategies, which reflects my analytical nature. I'm married to my college sweetheart, and together we share a love for technology and gaming. My typical online hours are in the evenings and weekends, when I engage with various gaming and technology communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering and over a decade of experience in the robotics industry, I have a deep understanding of mechanical systems and automation. My expertise extends to game theory and mechanics, fueled by years of playing and analyzing strategy games. I constantly seek out new information and trends in technology and gaming to stay ahead of the curve.
